# Büchi Automaton Runner

This notebook demonstrates how a **Deterministic Büchi Automaton (DBA)** processes an infinite word $\alpha = u \cdot v^\omega$. 

The run of the automaton on $\alpha$ produces an infinite sequence of states $\rho = \rho_0, \rho_1, \rho_2, \dots$.
The automaton accepts the word if the run visits at least one accepting state infinitely often. Formally, we define $In(\rho)$ as the set of states that appear infinitely often in the run. The acceptance condition is:
$$ In(\rho) \cap F \neq \emptyset $$

---

## Widget 1: Run $\alpha$ on a DBA

The running editor first consumes the one-time initialization event
`open`. The DBA below monitors the infinite operation stream that follows,
over
$\Gamma=\{\texttt{edit},\texttt{idle},\texttt{save}\}$. It accepts exactly
when `save` occurs infinitely often.

- States: $q_0$ (initial), $q_1$ (accepting, double circle)
- $F = \{q_1\}$

<script>
(function() {
  function parseInput(str) {
    return str.trim().split(/[\s,]+/).filter(s => s.length > 0);
  }

  const delta = {
    'q0': { 'edit': 'q0', 'idle': 'q0', 'save': 'q1' },
    'q1': { 'edit': 'q0', 'idle': 'q0', 'save': 'q1' }
  };
  const F = new Set(['q1']);

  function render() {
    const u = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb12-u').value);
    const v = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb12-v').value);
    
    if (v.length === 0) {
      document.getElementById('nb12-verdict').innerHTML = "<div class='verdict-box verdict-fail'>Period cannot be empty.</div>";
      return;
    }

    // We simulate enough steps to cover the stem + 3 periods
    const maxSteps = u.length + v.length * 3;
    const stripEl = document.getElementById('nb12-strip');
    stripEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    let state = 'q0';
    const visitedInPeriod = new Set();
    
    // Add initial state
    addStep(stripEl, '', state);
    
    for (let i = 0; i < maxSteps; i++) {
      let sym = i < u.length ? u[i] : v[(i - u.length) % v.length];
      
      // Unknown editor operations are treated as an implicit rejecting sink.
      if (!Object.hasOwn(delta[state], sym)) {
          document.getElementById('nb12-verdict').innerHTML = `<div class='verdict-box verdict-fail'>Unknown symbol: ${sym}. Alphabet is {edit, idle, save}.</div>`;
          return;
      }
      
      state = delta[state][sym];
      addStep(stripEl, sym, state);
      
      // Collect states visited during the periods
      if (i >= u.length) {
          visitedInPeriod.add(state);
      }
    }
    
    const inAlpha = Array.from(visitedInPeriod);
    const inF = inAlpha.filter(q => F.has(q));
    
    const verdictEl = document.getElementById('nb12-verdict');
    let html = `<div class="verdict-box ${inF.length > 0 ? 'verdict-pass' : 'verdict-fail'}">`;
    html += `<strong>In(&rho;)</strong> = { ${inAlpha.map(q => q.replace('q', 'q<sub>')).map(q => q+'</sub>').join(', ')} }<br>`;
    html += `<strong>In(&rho;) &cap; F</strong> = { ${inF.map(q => q.replace('q', 'q<sub>')).map(q => q+'</sub>').join(', ')} }<br><br>`;
    
    if (inF.length > 0) {
      html += `&rarr; <strong>Accepted!</strong> The run visits ${inF[0].replace('q', 'q<sub>')+'</sub>'} infinitely often.`;
    } else {
      html += `&rarr; <strong>Rejected!</strong> No accepting state is visited infinitely often.`;
    }
    html += `</div>`;
    verdictEl.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function addStep(container, sym, state) {
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'run-step';
    
    const symDiv = document.createElement('div');
    symDiv.className = 'run-sym';
    symDiv.innerHTML = sym === '' ? '&nbsp;' : sym;
    
    const stateDiv = document.createElement('div');
    stateDiv.className = 'run-state' + (F.has(state) ? ' accept' : '');
    stateDiv.innerHTML = state.replace('q', 'q<sub>') + '</sub>';
    
    box.appendChild(symDiv);
    box.appendChild(stateDiv);
    container.appendChild(box);
  }

  document.getElementById('nb12-update').addEventListener('click', render);
  document.getElementById('nb12-u').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter') render(); });
  document.getElementById('nb12-v').addEventListener('keyup', (e) => { if(e.key==='Enter') render(); });
  
  render();
})();
</script>
